assertions.assertion: States Spaces isolate persisted data but not process-level dependencies
assertions.rationale: Opens with 'Spaces isolate persisted data only' with same process and infrastructure not isolated.

assertions.assertion: Lists signing credentials, ASP.NET Core Data Protection, external caches, telemetry, rate limits and custom services as things to review
assertions.rationale: Lists signing credentials, Data Protection, external caches, telemetry, rate limits, custom services, email.

assertions.assertion: Notes shared signing credentials reduce cryptographic separation between spaces
assertions.rationale: Says shared signing keys reduce cryptographic separation and key compromise affects every space.

assertions.assertion: Notes user databases are not space-aware unless they use the shared IStorageFactory, while Duende User Management data is routed per space by default
assertions.rationale: Says user DBs not using IStorageFactory are not space-aware while Duende User Management is per space by default.

assertions.assertion: Suggests a deliberately separate architecture if users must be shared across spaces
assertions.rationale: Says a shared global directory needs a deliberately separate architecture.
